title: DayWill's Beekeepers
description: This is a small mod that adds beekeepers and their unique workstation to the game!
body:
This is a small mod that adds beekeepers and their unique workstation to the game!

This mod let you craft a Honey Extractor. It consumes 4 honey combs and give you one honey block! Also this mod adds a new Villager Profession - Beekeeper! It sells and buys things that you may need in Beekeeping!
